title: Scenic Nature Hike Close to Downtown Salt Lake City
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover the beauty of the Bonneville Shoreline Trail on a guided scenic nature hike just a short van ride from downtown Salt Lake City. This 3.3-mile loop trail offers moderate challenges with a 500-foot elevation gain, perfect for those seeking a refreshing outdoor experience. Your guide has intimate knowledge of the Geography, History and Nature of Salt Lake City and it's the perfect way to get a great outdoor experience and local knowledge. Enjoy sweeping views of Salt Lake City, the Great Salt Lake, and the majestic Wasatch and Oquirrh Mountain Ranges as you traverse this well-loved path frequented by locals, dog-lovers, and bikers. Whether you're visiting for business or pleasure, this hike is a quick and picturesque escape into nature.
